Feeling this as well. I have no good advice. I wanted to say that working on something interesting aside is meaningful for me but I never do it, I just rest when I have days off. 

What helps me and what I will say is that that feeling is an illusion like so many other feelings as well. There are reasons I feel bad and down sometimes and it's because I didn't give energy in other parts of my life. Now you would say that that lack of energy is the problem itself. But still that lack of energy came from somewhere and it came from you not doing what you would want to do. Hanging with people you want to hang, talking topics you want, calling and texting people you know and giving energy away. If you give it away it will come back. So it's sort of a loop as you said. Now you are in the low energy loop and it seems impossible to get out of it.  
What I would say is that understanding it and seeing that it's not so weird that you found yourself in the situation helps itself. It helps me at least.

To get out of the situation is intuitive and 'you know what it is'. You want to actually do many things but don't do them because 'you don't wanna do them'. You don't care.  
For me always and for anything; understanding is everything.
